contacts_has_identity.name: contacts_has_identity
contacts_has_identity.value: "contacts"."name" is not null or "contacts"."phone" is not null or "contacts"."email" is not null

conversations_ai_state_valid.name: conversations_ai_state_valid
conversations_ai_state_valid.value:
(
        (
          "conversations"."status" = 'OPEN'
          and (
            (
              "conversations"."ai_enabled" = true
              and "conversations"."assigned_to_user_id" is null
            )
            or (
              "conversations"."ai_enabled" = false
              and "conversations"."assigned_to_user_id" is not null
            )
          )
        )
        or (
          "conversations"."status" = 'HUMAN_REQUIRED'
          and "conversations"."ai_enabled" = false
          and "conversations"."assigned_to_user_id" is null
        )
        or (
          "conversations"."status" = 'CLOSED'
          and "conversations"."ai_enabled" = false
          and "conversations"."assigned_to_user_id" is null
        )
      )

messages_human_sender_user_valid.name: messages_human_sender_user_valid
messages_human_sender_user_valid.value:
("messages"."sender" = 'HUMAN' and "messages"."sender_user_id" is not null)
        or ("messages"."sender" <> 'HUMAN' and "messages"."sender_user_id" is null)
